input.reasoning_summary: The claim states that Meta's revenue for Q3 2026 (quarter ended September 30, 2026) increased by more than 20% year over year. Evidence E5 explicitly states that revenue for the three months ended September 30, 2026 increased by 26% compared to the same period in 2025. Since 26% is greater than 20%, the claim is supported. The evidence provides the actual year-over-year growth rate of 26%, which clearly exceeds the 20% threshold stated in the claim.
